task.description: Root cause diagnosis for GH-766: sch02_timer_polling_test TC-SCH-02-03 expected TransactionFailed but timer fires.

result.summary:
Root cause confirmed by ORCH via direct analysis:

1. TC-SCH-02-03 seeds a conflicting event with idempotency_key='timer-fired:{timer_id}' in events, then expects scheduler.pollDueTimers() to return TransactionFailed.

2. The ISS-0618 fix in scheduler.zig correctly propagates TransactionFailed when appendEventInTx fails. BUT the events table has no unique constraint on idempotency_key.

3. Migration 1147 (PAR-01 partitioning) deliberately removed the uq_event_idempotency unique index from events (because partitioning narrows uniqueness to per-partition) and replaced it with plat_event_idempotency (PRIMARY KEY on idempotency_key).

4. appendEventInTx in scheduler.zig does NOT insert into plat_event_idempotency. So duplicate events insert silently; ISS-0618's TransactionFailed path is never triggered.

Fix: (a) Update appendEventInTx to also INSERT INTO plat_event_idempotency(idempotency_key, event_id, created_at) — PRIMARY KEY violation will propagate as TransactionFailed via ISS-0618 fix. (b) Update TC-SCH-02-03 to pre-insert into plat_event_idempotency with the conflicting key (the direct events insert can be removed or kept).

No migration needed — plat_event_idempotency exists from migration 1147.
